description: Steady-state power map: P_electric = P_thermal * eta_cycle * eta_gen * f_PLR

unit.name: Generic 3000 MWth / 1000 MWe PWR (4-loop Westinghouse type)
unit.source: Todreas & Kazimi (2012), Nuclear Systems, 2nd ed., CRC Press

P_thermal_mw.note: Reactor core thermal power at full load

P_electric_mw.note: Net electrical output at full load

T_outlet_c.note: Coolant outlet temperature (hot leg) at full power

PLR_min.note: Minimum part-load ratio for stable operation

cp_coolant_kjkgk.note: Specific heat of pressurized water at ~310 degC, 155 bar

PLR_linear_derate_below.note: Below this PLR, efficiency linearly derated to 0 at PLR=0
